filed_stack.balance_basis: instrument balances before separately reported unamortized discounts/issuance costs; not a universal par-principal measure

instruments.name: DDTL 1.0
instruments.terms: Up to 2300 original commitment; quarterly amortization; final payment March 28, 2028. Contract spread not independently extracted.

instruments.name: DDTL 2.0
instruments.terms: Up to 7600 commitment; quarterly installments began January 2026; final payment five years after funding.

instruments.name: DDTL 2.1
instruments.terms: Separate 3000 tranche, not another 7600; SOFR+4.25%; quarterly installments began July 2026. Q2 supersedes FY25 maturity label.

instruments.name: DDTL 3.0
instruments.terms: 2600 facility; SOFR+4.00%; monthly installments began April 2026; 0.50% undrawn fee. Required hedge >=75% anticipated floating loans; FY25 stated compliance.

instruments.name: DDTL 5.0
instruments.terms: 3100 facility, SOFR+4.50%; draw period ended September 30, 2026; installments start November 2026. Narrative expects final payment May 2031 while debt table lists November 2031: unresolved distinction. 0.50% undrawn fee; >=95% anticipated floating hedge required.

instruments.name: 2030 senior notes
instruments.terms: 9.250% cash coupon; senior unsecured; June 1, 2030 maturity.

instruments.name: 2031 9.00% senior notes
instruments.terms: 9.000% cash coupon; senior unsecured. Effective rate rounded by filing differs from coupon.

instruments.name: 2031 9.75% senior notes
instruments.terms: 9.750% coupon; senior unsecured; October 1, 2031 maturity; $27M issuance costs at issuance.

instruments.name: 2032 9.625% senior notes
instruments.terms: 9.625% coupon; senior unsecured; July 15, 2032; $20M debt discount and issuance costs.

instruments.name: 2032 EUR senior notes
instruments.terms: 8.500% coupon; original EUR2000M principal; filing USD carrying translation retained rather than new spot FX. Cross-currency swap covers EUR2000M; no assumed all-in synthetic USD rate. $41M issuance costs.

instruments.name: 2031 convertible senior notes
instruments.terms: 1.75% cash coupon; senior unsecured; $57M issuance costs at issuance. Equity conversion optional/conditional, not guaranteed principal extinguishment.

instruments.name: 2032 convertible senior notes
instruments.terms: 1.75% coupon; October 1, 2032; $70M discount/issuance costs, $492M capped-call outlay; initial conversion $119.60, cap $230. Capped-call spending is not recurring coupon.

instruments.name: Acquisition convertible promissory notes
instruments.terms: $172M principal settled in shares in April 2026 at $106.61 conversion price; no remaining balance.

instruments.name: Revolver
instruments.terms: 2500 commitment; previous balance repaid April 2026; 533 letters of credit consume availability; about 2000 remaining June capacity. 0.25% undrawn fee. August 1200 draw belongs in overlay.

instruments.name: OEM/software financing, recourse
instruments.terms: Secured equipment/vendor financing; exact fixed/floating tranche split not extracted. OEM agreements generally one to three years; software generally less than five. Not all this balance is a short-term bullet.

instruments.name: Magnetar/MagAI obligation
instruments.terms: In-substance debt from refundable capacity prepayment with termination-for-convenience rights; $100M paid June 2026. FY25 classified current despite later stated term: do not equate term date to cash-call date.

instruments.name: DDTL 4.0
instruments.terms: 8500 facility; SOFR+2.25% or blended Treasury+2.00%; about 1400 floating/1500 fixed at June (rounded). Draw deadline June 30, 2027; 0.50% undrawn fee. Monthly principal commencement depends on draw/site events. >=95% anticipated floating hedge required after specified future dates. $151M capitalized financing costs.

instruments.name: OEM/software financing, non-recourse
instruments.terms: Shorter vendor obligations included. Filing says short-term OEM debt weighted-average rate 9%; it does not disclose separate short-term-only balance here.

subsequent_events.security: Substantially all borrower/sub assets and 100% borrower equity pledge; unconditional parent/sub guarantees
subsequent_events.covenant: DSCR >=1.35x starting first full month after earlier of commitments reduced to zero or December 31, 2026

subsequent_events.note: Final closed terms supersede proposed $3B/3.5B and estimated 2.625% presentation assumptions. No automatic conversion if stock remains below strike.

additive_bridge.unknown_offsets: Subtract post-June repayments; add further DDTL/OEM draws; adjust foreign currency and other carrying movements. Those are not fully disclosed until next balance sheet.

dcsp.note: 13% note asset, 15% imputed financing obligation and 13% finance lease; disclosed separately/set off in other assets. Do not blindly add offset gross figures to net debt.

other_obligations.note: Operating rent already enters contract EBITDA; avoid deducting full lease liability and future rent twice in a valuation. Deferred revenue is an obligation to deliver services, not another coupon debt tranche.

financing_cost_bridge.note: The $558M debt-note expense is not the full consolidated $640M interest measure; other financing components include finance leases and revenue agreements. No full $82M allocation asserted.

management_model.note: Asset-level EBITDA covers data-center lease, power and direct costs, not all parent costs/taxes. Debt amortizes against customer receipts; remaining parent capital sources include prepayments, stabilized cash, corporate debt/OEM/convertibles/equity.

rate_exposure.risk_factor: Filing describes majority of Credit Facilities variable-rate debt as unhedged; hedge requirements with future commencement are not proof all debt is fixed today.
rate_exposure.annualization_note: Quarterly $30M x4 x3, illustrative June-exposure sensitivity, not today's exact net-of-all-swaps cash sensitivity.

capacity.note: Framework uses NVIDIA financial strength selectively for land/power/shell; no disclosed blanket guarantee or irrevocable full-fleet funding amount.

scenarios.formula: extra_interest=average_affected_principal*rate_delta*time_fraction; price_premium=extra_interest/(repricable_revenue*incremental_contribution). No pass-through on already-fixed contracts assumed.

unknowns: Exact October 22 debt/cash balance and post-June principal repayments
Individual customer/facility cash waterfall and loan amortization schedules beyond filed summaries
Current hedge coverage, swap strike rates, timing and collateral
Individual OEM fixed/floating rates and short-term-only maturity amounts
NVIDIA binding support amounts beyond disclosed $2B equity and framework
A committed funding schedule for each incremental MW through >5GW
Current secondary-market yield not queried; never replace existing coupons with it
Future renewal rates, timing of customer acceptance and financing/pricing pass-through are assumptions
